objective: Convert one explicitly selected Dayline task into a bounded research/recovery/implementation packet that helps the human act, without taking over messaging, calendar, money, accounts, or canonical repository authority.

trigger.source: Explicit COPY HERMES PACKET action in Atlas Dayline LIVE 0.2

authority: READ / FETCH / RESEARCH / RECOVER / ANALYZE / PREPARE_PACKET only
do_not_touch: Do not send or reply to messages.
Do not purchase, spend, or contact sellers.
Do not write or merge canonical repository state from this packet alone.
Do not widen one Dayline task into a new framework or backlog.
Do not infer a commitment from a DERIVED COMMS signal; the upstream explicit TARGET is the promotion event.
operation: Recover the selected task exactly, including provenance/sourceRef.
If sourceRef points to COMMS, preserve source id/message/character address and DERIVED/HUMAN origin.
State the smallest missing fact or action blocking execution.
Research/recover only what materially reduces that blocker.
Produce at most one execution packet, draft, checklist, comparison, or exact next-action recommendation.
Return and stop; do not self-assign a sequel.

return_contract.rule: ONE_NEXT must be executable and bounded; if it requires human/world authority, name the gate rather than acting through it.

success: The human can perform or authorize one clearer real-world action with less re-entry cost; no new coordination surface is created.
stop: One bounded packet or explicit BLOCKED/NO_GAIN.
